title: Volunteer with Oratorio
description:
Thank you for offering your gift! There is a place for everyone, you do NOT have to sing or attend rehearsals to serve.

Pathway: Application > Online orientation > Trial assignment > Confirmation into a unit.

questions.title: Which kind of volunteering suits you best?
questions.help: Choose your MAIN area. You can tick other areas you are interested in on the last page.
options: Sing or perform on stage (Choir, Band, Drama & Comedy, Dance) – attends rehearsals
Serve at the venue in Lagos on concert day (ushering, welfare, media, etc.) – no rehearsals
Prayer & Intercession team – online prayer meetings, from anywhere
Serve online from anywhere (watch party, ambassador, chat moderator, content)
Join the Planning Committee (help organise the concert) – online meetings
